$comment: DeTars-maintained layer on top of the synced upstream prices. USD per 1M tokens. `prices` win over every upstream source for the same key; `providerAliases` map DeTars runtime provider ids (subscription / OAuth routes, regional endpoints) to the vendor whose list price applies. Keys are lowercase `provider/model`. `requiredKeys` are models DeTars users run daily; validation fails if a sync drops any of them, so an upstream format change cannot silently empty the table.
